verdict.rationale: Paxos documents API-based fiat-to-stablecoin conversion (mint orchestration converts USD to stablecoins in one call) and fiat deposit/withdrawal via wire transfer/CUBIX, which developers could use to build an onramp. However, there is no documented pre-built embeddable widget for end users, and funding is limited to bank/wire methods (CUBIX, Fedwire, SWIFT) with no mention of card payments. missing for 10: a documented UI widget/embeddable component, card payment support, evidence of consumer-facing onramp UX rather than raw backend APIs.
